newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland meets criteria, aims for EMU start-fin min.
newsitem.headline: Finland meets criteria, aims for EMU start-fin min.

text.p: Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto on Wednesday reiterated that Finland aimed to be in EMU from the start in 1999.

"The government's point of departure in its (EMU) preparations has been that the euro currency area will be implemented on schedule, and that the most natural alternative for Finland is to be there from the start," he told a seminar.
Decisions on the countries joining EMU in 1999 will be made early next year, based on performance in 1997, Niinisto said.
"In the light of information available today, Finland meets all the criteria," he said.

The EU Commission said on Wednesday in a forecast the Finnish public sector deficit and debt in relation to gross domestic product (GDP) in 1997 and 1998 would be well inside the criteria for membership of EMU.
